Find the common elements between two lists.

Supplied answer
list1 = [1, 23, 44, 4]
list2 = [2, 4, 23, 5]
common = list(set(list1) & set(list2)) # & means intersection
print(sorted(common)) # [4, 23]
# without sets
print([x for x in list1 if x in list2])
Note: The & operator only works on sets, not on lists - convert first.
